note: Frozen MTP-off box-state baseline for the authoritative bench cell. An MTP-on candidate that wants promotion talk must carry a same-shape OFF control measured in the same session whose tg lands inside `band`; a window outside the band is NOT comparable and the gate refuses. Regenerate only by a declared re-baseline (docs/ACCEPT_LEVERS_AND_DIRTY_BOX_PAIR_2026-09-26.md §12). v3 (2026-09-27 evening): the corridor grew from 5 to 7 accepted samples (a 4-run back-to-back null series was added) and `stable_window` now states what today's data can/cannot support: the 10.84-12.02 range is mostly ONE-HIT REP BIMODALITY, not slow drift -- inside a 5-minute window the run medians spread 1.52%, while a single arm's two agreeing reps agree to <=1%. v4 (2026-09-28): added the `output_function` section -- the gate's ELIGIBLE means the PAIR is comparable, not that an MTP-on number is a percentage of MTP-off (B1, docs/MTP_CALIBER_REDEFINE_CHARTER_2026-09-28.md). No measured value changed in v4; the anchor stays 11.61 t/s.
frozen_scope: the anchor POINT; the window CLASS is `corridor`, the citation rules are `stable_window`

output_function.role: the anchor was measured with MTP off; an MTP-on candidate is a DIFFERENT output function, not a faster version of this one
output_function.root_cause: MTP on makes need_n_rs_seq() (src/llama.cpp/common/common.h:395) return draft.n_max > 0, so src/llama.cpp/src/models/delta-net-base.cpp:494 (if cparams.n_rs_seq == 0) takes the K-slot rollback branch instead of the in-place write-back -- the reduction width changes (gdn 30->60, conv_input 30->150) and the FIRST decode already differs (pos=209: off 19.22745 vs on 19.25835, greedy).
output_function.why_no_knob_can_undo_it: n_max=0 is rejected by GGML_ASSERT as an illegal configuration, so there is no configuration with MTP on and n_rs_seq == 0. Proven at source level 2026-09-28 (docs/MTP_BITIDENT_CLOSEOUT_2026-09-28.md, hypothesis H8).
output_function.quality_note: the MTP-on output is NOT a quality defect: both sides are fluent and semantically equivalent under greedy decoding. It is a different function, which is why a t/s ratio between them is undefined rather than merely noisy.
output_function.claim_rule: ELIGIBLE (pair comparability) != same output function (inter-comparability). When output_function.identical is false, an MTP-on t/s may be cited only as 't/s under the MTP-on output function' and MUST NOT be written as 'X% of off' or 'X% faster than off' -- even when the pair is comparable and on is the faster of the two.
output_function.enforced_by: scripts/check/mtp_promotion_gate.py: output_function.identical and comparability.interpretable_speedup. Its --selftest asserts both (18 cases) and four mutants were verified to turn it red, so the layer is not decorative.

corridor.role: window-class distribution ONLY. It answers "which single points are the same kind of window", and it is NOT the comparison precision: the seven accepted samples span 8.97%, i.e. 3x the pair threshold, so feeding the corridor in as `off.reps` is REFUSED by mtp_promotion_gate.py rule 4 (demonstrated 2026-09-27). Promotion talk still needs a paired ABBA/interleaved session whose own repeats are tight.
corridor.staleness_rule: the corridor artifact pins `ingest.baseline_md5` (this file's md5 at ingest time) -- after ANY edit here, re-run the reproduce command below so the pinned hash is not stale. The hash is deliberately one-way: this file never carries the artifact's md5, so the two can't lock each other.

stable_window.definition: 可引用的窗 = 同 head、同 cell、health=clean（rep_shape=tight、thermal hist 無 MODERATE/HEAVY、sampler coverage>=0.90、wall<=1.3x 同批健康中位），且與同伴樣本間隔 <=10 分鐘。任何 <=3% 的宣稱還必須來自這個窗內的配對（ABBA／交錯、兩側各 >=2 reps、兩側 spread<=3%）。

rep_level.note: 同一個 arm 的三個 rep 是雙模的：要嘛 2 個互差 <=1%（第 3 個也 <=2%），要嘛其中 1 個掉 3-8%。今天 11 支 run 裡有 8 支是後者。

measured_scales_2026-09-27.reading: 單讀對單讀 1σ≈3.0%（走廊 7 支，sd 0.349 t/s = 2.99%）、最小可辨差 ≈8.5%（95%，2*sqrt(2)*sigma）；同 5 分鐘窗內的 run 中位數 spread=1.52%（19:29-19:34 四支，2 支 accepted 11.66/11.48）。也就是說 10.84-12.02 這個範圍主要是『那次跑裡有一個 rep 被撞到』的混合值，不是同一個窗慢慢漂。

confounds_found.name: thermal / pool carry-over in back-to-back runs
confounds_found.read: 19:29-19:34 四支背對背：pp 302.85 -> 281.65 -> 269.22 -> 258.01（單調 -14.8%），tg 只 -3.0%；thermal hist 第 3 支起出現 MODERATE/HEAVY（32/151、69/153），worst 標籤在啟動前仍是 NOMINAL
confounds_found.implication: 連續跑的第 3 支起不可當對照；A/B 必須交錯（ABBA）且 >2 支要留冷卻段。pp 對 carry-over 的敏感度遠大於 tg，所以任何 pp 比較更要用交錯。

confounds_found.name: sampler starvation (machine-level stall)
confounds_found.read: sampler coverage = thermal.n*interval/wall：正常 0.91-0.97、冷窗 0.74、13:55 崩壞 0.118
confounds_found.implication: 這是唯一能自動抓到『整台機器 stall』的免費見證，而且它同時抓到了冷窗（09:46，不同 build）與崩壞（13:55）。任何『這支就是慢』的結論都應該先看它。

confounds_found.name: no recorded box variable tracks tg
confounds_found.read: 對 5 支晨間樣本算 Spearman(tg, x)：swap 存量 0.00、run 內 swap 成長 -0.30、啟動時 free +0.30、wired 成長 -0.30、per-miss 延遲 +0.40（方向相反）、run 內 pagein 率 ~0.00（扣掉沒有 sys_rate 的那支後）、pp +0.60；對 clock 也只有 +0.10
confounds_found.implication: 不要把 10.84-12.02 讀成某個開關或某個環境變數的線性效應；它與任何單一被記錄的變數都沒有可用的相關。注意 pagein 率那格：把它當 0 代入會得到 -0.80 的假相關 —— 缺件不能當 0（本 repo 已踩過這個坑）。

stable_window.what_this_does_not_say: 它沒有說 tg 是常數：走廊 1σ=3.0%（7 樣本），只是說這個散佈在今天的資料裡不是趨勢、不是任何單一記錄變數，而主要是 rep 級雙模 + 窗級慢漂的混合；要把它壓到 3% 以下，只能靠配對與交錯，不是靠挑最高分。

band.role: window-class anchor ONLY -- not the comparison precision
band.why: cross-window single readings are NOT 3%: the same frozen-shape off cell read 11.61 t/s at 10:44 and 10.97 t/s at 10:59 (-5.5% in 15 min, swap +1407 MiB during the run), and paired_ab.py's header records six unpaired interleaved arms of one engine spanning 1.54x while reps inside one arm agreed to 0.6-2%. The 3% lives in the PAIRING and is enforced on the pair's own repeats by mtp_promotion_gate.py v2. The corridor shows the same thing seven times over (spread 8.97% over 95 minutes + one 5-minute segment), and it fits inside this +/-15% band ([9.87, 13.35]) -- the band width was right, the single point was the wrong shape.
